Texas, Turkeys and Wild Tastes | Modern Hunter

- Tuesday August 25, 2026 - DDH Staff
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

The team travels to the rugged Texas Hill Country for a Rio Grande turkey hunt on the historic YO Ranch. After working to call in a wary gobbler, the focus shifts to the camp kitchen for a blind mystery taste test that leaves everyone guessing what’s on their plate.

GROW 'EM BIG

Designing Around Access for Whitetails

Natural high-odds, low-impact stand setups are extremely rare in nature. On this episode of Grow 'Em Big, host Steve Bartylla explains why successful whitetail land management starts with entry and exit access. Learn how to manufacture low-impact, high-odds hunting setups by utilizing existing property boundaries, roads, creeks, and terrain features to stay undetected all season long.
